name: Chronicle
insight: Backed by a $7.5M seed from Accel and Square Peg with angels from Apple, Google and Stripe; opened publicly in 2025.
tagline: AI presentation maker that turns a prompt into a polished, on-brand deck.
description: Chronicle is a presentation tool that generates entire slide decks from a prompt and lets you refine them on a widget-based canvas. Rather than editing one slide at a time, its AI agent — pitched as "Cursor for presentations" — drafts, restyles, and restructures whole decks, embedding content from other tools and keeping output on-brand. It targets startups and modern teams who want polished decks without a designer.
edge: Pitches itself as "Cursor for presentations" — an AI agent that drafts and restyles entire decks on a canvas, not just one slide at a time.
pros: AI restyles and restructures whole decks

references.title: Accel, Square Peg back Chronicle's tool for presentations
